A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same NegoCollab work and provide readable methods, equations, eight tables, eight figures, Appendices A–C, and the checklist. V1's missing bibliography and unresolved citations are document defects, not extraction gaps, and do not prevent substantive comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original collaborative-perception experiments on OPV2V-H, V2V4Real, and DAIR-V2X, including performance comparisons, localization robustness, and appendix ablations.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix B, including benchmark comparisons, robustness tests, and component ablations.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix C retain the same negotiator, sender–receiver architecture, alignment losses, two-stage training, and new-agent adaptation procedure. Resolved component citations do not change the method.

E1.justification: Both evaluate collaborative detection on OPV2V-H, V2V4Real, and DAIR-V2X with the same homogeneous and heterogeneous agent combinations, initial alliances, and localization-noise scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods, including MPDA, PnPDA, their protocol variants, STAMP, and NegoCollab-P where originally evaluated. Appendix B retains Late Fusion and the same component alternatives.

E3.justification: The reported AP thresholds, agent and encoder configurations, training stages, and pose-noise settings are unchanged. Section 4.1, Table 5, and Appendix B introduce no revised evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The localization robustness and domain-gap analyses, training-loss ablation, initial-alliance comparison, late-fusion robustness comparison, and component ablations are all retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental confidence intervals, error bars, seeds, or repeated-run counts. Checklist item 7 gives the same explanation that statistical significance analysis was not performed because observed randomness was minimal.

E6.justification: All corresponding numerical result entries and plotted findings are unchanged, including Appendix B. For example, Table 1 retains NegoCollab's m1m2 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 values of 0.872/0.765; the late-fusion and ablation results also match.

T1.justification: Equations 1–27 and their mathematical definitions remain unchanged. Neither version supplies theoretical propositions or proofs, and the checklist's statement that no theoretical derivation is involved is retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about negotiated common representations, multidimensional alignment, and performance against common-representation methods and selected one-to-one adaptation settings.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning multimodal knowledge distillation, initial-alliance selection, and localization robustness are unchanged. Both conclusions acknowledge information loss when new agents align to a fixed negotiated representation.

D1.justification: Appendix A retains the RTX 4090 hardware, Adam optimizer, 0.001 initial learning rate, training-time and memory estimates, and agent configurations. Appendix C's implementation explanations and the checklist's GitHub availability statement are unchanged; no new access instructions are supplied.

R1.justification: V1 contains unresolved citation placeholders and no bibliography. V2 supplies named citations throughout the paper and appendices and adds the References section, identifying sources such as STAMP, collaborative-perception datasets, and distillation methods. This substantially restores explicit attribution, although the related-work narrative and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 resolves citation placeholders, adds the References section, and removes the duplicated full stop in the abstract. The existing prose, section sequence, terminology, and appendix organization otherwise remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Expanded citations cause text and equation reflow; Table 2 moves from page 8 to page 9, and Figures 3–4 move lower on page 9. The bibliography precedes the appendices. Figure artwork and table structures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Replacing unresolved citations and supplying the missing bibliography improves attribution and lets readers identify the sources behind the methods and comparisons. The overall gain is in documentation and traceability; the scientific argument and empirical support are unchanged. Some presentation defects, including the unresolved table reference in Appendix B.2, remain.
